description: Perform a reliability analysis on the Extraversion items (E1, E2, E3, E4, E5) in the BFI25 dataset. Identify items with negative item-total correlations (reverse-coded items), correct for them in the reliability analysis, and note the resulting Cronbach's Alpha. Then, create a new Computed Variable named 'Extraversion_Score' that represents the mean of the 5 items, manually implementing the reverse coding logic for the identified items (Formula hint: for a 1-6 scale, reverse x as '7-x'). Save the project as 'Extraversion_Scale.omv' and report the corrected Alpha and the Extraversion_Score for the first participant in 'scale_report.txt'.
